dossier_meta.paper: Additive bases and flows in graphs
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Antisymmetric variant of Jaeger's weak 3-flow conjecture
dossier_meta.statement_text: There is a constant $k$ such that every directed $k$-edge-connected graph has a $\mathbb{Z}_5$-antisymmetric flow.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors present this as the natural antisymmetric analogue of Jaeger's weak 3-flow conjecture (which was solved by Thomassen and later improved to 6-edge-connectivity by Lovász et al.). The note $\mathbb{Z}_5$ is best possible since $\mathbb{Z}_2$, $\mathbb{Z}_3$, and $\mathbb{Z}_4$ cannot support antisymmetric flows in general.
